disclaimer: Prototype knowledge base for a hackathon decision-support tool. Values are general (blanket) recommendations taken from the cited public documents, or explicitly labelled assumptions. They are not site-specific advice and must be checked against the state package of practices, a soil-testing laboratory and a qualified agronomist.

statusLegend.REFERENCED: Value copied from the cited source document (text retrieved and checked on 2026-09-27).
statusLegend.MAPPING_ASSUMPTION: Value is from the cited source, but its timing was mapped by us onto the growth-stage list used in this application.
statusLegend.PROTOTYPE_ASSUMPTION: Not taken from a verified source. Chosen for the prototype and documented as such.
statusLegend.DERIVED: Computed from physical constants (no agronomic judgement).

soilTest.ratingNotes: Boundaries are inclusive in the MEDIUM class (e.g. N = 280 or 560 is MEDIUM). The cited table does not state explicitly whether P and K are elemental or oxide; we read them as elemental, matching how soil_records stores values [PROTOTYPE_ASSUMPTION]. Other Indian sources use slightly different limits (e.g. K 108 instead of 118, organic carbon 0.75 % instead of 1.0 %).

adjustmentFactors.note: MEDIUM fertility is treated as equal to the general recommendation; LOW increases and HIGH decreases each nutrient's dose by 25 %. A soil-test-rating adjustment of this kind is described in secondary literature on Indian soil-testing practice (reported as 25-30 %), but we could not retrieve a primary source for the exact percentage, so it is an assumption. It is NOT a soil-test crop response (STCR) equation; STCR coefficients are location-specific and are not used.

organicCarbonPercent.use: reported only; does not change the calculation

ph.use: warnings only; does not change the calculation

maxAgeDays.note: Soil tests older than 3 years produce a warning.

windowDaysBeforeSowing.note: Applications from 30 days before the sowing date up to today count toward this crop (covers pre-plant basal doses).

fallbackLookbackDays.note: If the field has no sowing date, applications in the last 150 days count.

previousApplications.carryOver: Nutrients from earlier crops, organic manures and residual fertilizer are NOT credited [PROTOTYPE_ASSUMPTION].

lateSowingAfter.note: 'Irrigated, late sown (After 25th Nov.)' for NHZ, NWPZ and NEPZ. CZ/PZ/SHZ define late sowing slightly later; one threshold is used for all zones [PROTOTYPE_ASSUMPTION].
